rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for ancient times and, in ordinary Cantonese, the historical period before the Middle Ages.

example.english: People in antiquity already knew how to use waterwheels.
example.traditional: 古代嘅歐洲人已經識得用水車。
example.jyutping: gu2 doi6 ge3 au1 zau1 jan4 ji5 ging1 sik1 dak1 jung6 seoi2 ce1

rows.note: Use this for a physical ancient object or relic, especially an artifact; a specific monument may instead be called 古蹟.

example.english: This piece of antiquity is said to have been left behind from ancient Rome.
example.traditional: 呢件古物據講係古羅馬時代留下嚟㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 gu2 mat6 geoi3 gong2 hai6 gu2 lo4 maa5 si4 doi6 lau4 haa6 lai4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when antiquity refers to the people who lived in ancient times.

example.english: People in antiquity had no electricity or telephones, yet they could live wisely.
example.traditional: 古人冇電冇電話，都可以過得好有智慧。
example.jyutping: gu2 jan4 mou5 din6 mou5 din6 waa2 dou1 ho2 ji5 gwo3 dak1 hou2 jau5 zi3 wai6
